text: RF2: nothing tests that an open SSE stream closes after revoke/disable. Mutation: replace authenticate() in the ping callback (src/http/sse.ts:159) with false -> sse.test.ts passes. PING_MS=20000 is a hard-coded const, so a test would wait 20 s; make it injectable. At HEAD I measured the stream closing at 19999 ms, so behavior is correct.
